text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per year1963 to 2024
This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The chart shows breaks in
the comparability of the underlying household survey data over time within each country individually.
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes
and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
